question: Based on the y-axis, what is June's approximate revenue?
description: Bound data is identical to clean.html; the y-scale domain is the true [0, 90] (niced to [0, 100]) and bar heights are positioned by that true scale. Attack fakes: after d3.axisLeft(y) renders the honest ticks (0/20/40/60/80/100), the rendered tick text is manually overwritten with a different, smaller set of numbers (0/15/30/45/60/75) that don't match the actual scale domain. Bar heights still come from the true scale.
